en.summary: Friday 6 November 2026: the Moon stays in Libra all day near 8°, waning and about 9% lit, and forms an almost exact opposition to Saturn retrograde in Aries. Venus, retrograde in Libra, makes a sextile to Jupiter and Mars and a trine to the North Node. The Sun remains near Mercury, which is retrograde in Scorpio, while Mars stays conjunct Jupiter in Leo and opposite the North Node.

signs.belier:
Aries, a serious talk with a partner clears the air: the Moon stays in Libra all day in your sector of partnerships, waning and about 9% lit, and it forms an almost exact opposition to Saturn retrograde in Aries in your sector of self and initiative.

That Moon–Saturn line asks for mature boundaries, patience and fewer empty promises. Venus, still retrograde in Libra, makes a sextile to Jupiter and Mars and a trine to the North Node, so kindness and a revisited approach can ease the seriousness without denying it. The Sun remains near retrograde Mercury in Scorpio, favouring honest but careful speech.

Mars, your ruler, still with Jupiter in Leo, gives courage after the hard talk if you stay fair. Mars opposite the North Node warns against forcing a group win. Use the thin waning Moon to finish a duty cleanly rather than launching something flashy.

fr.summary: Vendredi 6 novembre 2026 : la Lune reste en Balance toute la journée vers 8°, décroissante et éclairée à 9 % environ, et forme une opposition presque exacte à Saturne rétrograde en Bélier. Vénus, rétrograde en Balance, forme un sextile à Jupiter et à Mars ainsi qu’un trigone au Nœud nord. Le Soleil reste près de Mercure, rétrograde en Scorpion, tandis que Mars reste conjoint à Jupiter en Lion et opposé au Nœud nord.
